source.title: British Columbia Housing Management Commission, Annual Report 1978 (Legislative Library of British Columbia copy)

summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the British Columbia Housing Management Commission's house-shaped BC symbol and three-line name, from its 1978 annual report (cover, title page and an enlarged symbol on PDF page 13). The package's black and white single-colour versions are adaptations and are not collected. See package-README.md and review/comparison.webp.

assets.label: BC Housing Management Commission — House symbol and name, 1978 (reconstruction)
assets.sourceLocator: Annual Report 1978, cover and title page (PDF pages 2–3), with the enlarged symbol on PDF page 13; a Legislative Library of British Columbia copy, supplied
assets.dateNote: The report’s year, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: BC drawn as a house — a pitched roof over the two letters, with a slit under the roof — beside “British Columbia Housing Management Commission” on three lines, in brown.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the symbol is two drawn paths (no automatic tracing) and the name is set in Nimbus Sans Bold outlines with close spacing; the original typeface is not verified, and the brown (#836458) approximates the scan.
